lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spot clusters originating posterior to the gill slits and extending across the lateral flank with relatively uniform spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect the horizontal spot rows to form a visible grid-like pattern on the mid-section of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple longitudinal ridges running horizontally along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light dorsal edges to shadowed ventral edges.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of small yellow high-chroma objects is visible near the mouth and the leading edge of the left pectoral fin.
